{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and count QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_qa = len(qa_orders)

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel
table = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['converted'], normalize='index')

effect = table.loc['email', 1] - table.loc['paid_search', 1]

# Print key numbers
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {num_qa}')
print(f'Number of completed orders after cleaning: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'Conversion rate (email): {table.loc["email", 1]:.4f}')
print(f'Conversion rate (paid_search): {table.loc["paid_search", 1]:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {effect:.6f}')"}
